title: Typical process parameters for SBR configurations (for unsettled sludge)
rows: * For Phosphorous ≤ 1 mg/L, after bio-P removal, metal precipitant (Fe³⁺ or Al³⁺) shall be added. Sludge yield factor and sludge age not applicable for primary settled sewage; typical primary TSS removal 60%, BOD 30%.

cell_spans.description: Printed asterisk note spans the full table width as the last row

markdown:
| S. No. | Parameters | Units | Continuous Flow and Intermittent Decant | Intermittent Flow and Intermittent Decant |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | F/M ratio | d⁻¹ | 0.05 - 0.08 | 0.05 - 0.3 |
| 2 | Sludge Age | d | 15 - 20 | 4 - 20 |
| 3 | Sludge Yield | kg dry solids/ kg BOD | 0.75 - 0.85 | 0.75 - 1.0 |
| 4 | MLSS | mg/L | 3,000 - 4,000 | 3,500 – 5,000 |
| 5 | Cycle Time | h | 4 - 8 | 2.5 - 6 |
| 6 | Settling Time | h | > 0.5 | > 0.5 |

notes: No Source line is printed for this table.
The asterisk note is printed inside the ruled table as a full-width row below the last data row; transcribed as the last row with a full-width span.
Printed as 'Phosphorous' in the asterisk note (not 'Phosphorus'); retained, not corrected.
Row 4: the value cells print '3,000 - 4,000' and '3,500 – 5,000'. The second range uses a longer dash than the first and than every other range in the table; both forms are retained as printed.
Printed header 'S. No.' is set on two lines ('S.' over 'No.').
Rows 9 to 11: 'Process Oxygen' prints no unit and no values; the sub-rows 'BOD' and 'TKN' carry the values and their S. No. cells are blank as printed.
Printed unit 'd-1' has a superscript minus one; written d⁻¹. Printed 'kg O2/kg BOD' and 'kg O2/kg TN' use a subscript 2; written O₂.
Row 8 prints a hyphen as its unit ('-') and 'Peak Flow' in both value columns; retained.
Printed as 'Fill Volume Base' and 'Settling Time'; retained.
The two value-column headings are printed across four lines each ('Continuous / Flow and / Intermittent / Decant'); joined with spaces.

transcription.method: Direct viewing of the annotation-cleaned 144 dpi page renders and 260-800 dpi crops of the same pages; no OCR, no paid service
transcription.observations: Table read from two 400 dpi crops; the header block, all nine numbered rows, the BOD/TKN sub-rows and the asterisk note read separately. The dash in '3,500 – 5,000' was compared against '3,000 - 4,000' at 400 dpi and is visibly longer.

visual_recheck.method: Distinct parent comparison of each selected source-region crop and larger zoom, without whole-page review; not independent human review.
visual_recheck.observations: Compared every selected table header, cell and source/footnote text. Preserved units, printed precision, inequalities and blank cells. Joined wrapped Sludge Yield unit with a single space in both structured cells and Markdown.
